data.what_it_does: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Limited operates a network of super-specialty hospitals in the National Capital Region (NCR) of Delhi, India, providing medical and trauma care services. The company has expanded its capacity significantly and is positioning itself in the Medical Value Travel (MVT) segment by leveraging its proximity to Noida International Airport to attract international patients seeking specialized healthcare in India.

bull.text: Revenue and PAT have compounded at 36.2% and 37.1% CAGR over three years, reaching TTM ₹1,334 Cr and ₹174 Cr respectively.
Balance sheet is conservatively leveraged with debt-to-equity of 0.15, while quarterly revenue has sequentially grown from ₹279 Cr in Sep 2025 to ₹393 Cr in Jun 2026.
Management targets 5,000–6,000 beds (adding ~3,000 in 3–4 years) and is positioning for Medical Value Travel leveraging proximity to Noida International Airport.

bear.text: Operating margin has declined from 28.2% three years ago to 25.3% TTM and ROCE remains modest at 13%.
Cash conversion is weak with operating cash flow / PAT averaging only 0.8 over the last three years.

Aggressive ₹1,500 Cr capex plan relies 70% on acquisitions, yet new hospitals target 25–27% EBITDA margin only in two years and current consolidated EBITDA margin guidance of 24–25% has delivered just 23.4% in the latest quarter.
